description_en: Modifies the number of nodes or the query execution mode for a resource group of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBResourceGroup接口变更数仓版集群资源组的节点数量或查询模式
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-resource-group --db-cluster-id am-bp1ub9grke10000 --group-name test_group --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the cluster IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The minimum amount of reserved computing resources. Unit: AnalyticDB compute unit (ACU).

When GroupType is set to interactive, set this parameter to 16ACU.
When GroupType is set to job, set this parameter to 0ACU
parameters.help_zh:
最小计算预留资源。
当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最小为16ACU。
当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最小为0ACU
parameters.name: min_compute_resource

parameters.help_en:
The maximum amount of reserved computing resources, which refers to the amount of resources that are not allocated in the cluster. Unit: ACU.

When GroupType is set to interactive, set this parameter to a value in increments of 16ACU.
When GroupType is set to job, set this parameter to a value in increments of 8ACU
parameters.help_zh:
最大计算预留资源。
当资源组类型为Interactive时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为16ACU。
当资源组类型为Job时，计算预留资源最大为集群当前未分配资源，步长为8ACU
parameters.name: max_compute_resource

parameters.help_en: The resource specifications of a single compute cluster. Unit: ACU
parameters.name: cluster_size_resource

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of compute clusters that are required in the resource group. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 资源组内至少需要运行的Cluster个数，最小为1
parameters.name: min_cluster_count

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of compute clusters that are allowed in the resource group. Maximum value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 资源组内最多可以运行的Cluster个数，最大为10
parameters.name: max_cluster_count

parameters.help_en:
The working mode of the resource group. Valid values:

Disable (default)
AutoScale
parameters.help_zh:
资源组模式，取值：

Disable（默认）：常规模式。
AutoScale：自动弹性模式
parameters.name: cluster_mode

parameters.help_en: The Spark application configuration parameters that can be applied to all Spark jobs executed in the resource group. If you want to configure parameters for a specific Spark job, you can specify values for the parameters in the code editor when you submit the job
parameters.help_zh: Spark应用配置参数，应用于该资源组执行的所有Spark作业。如需为某个Spark作业单独配置参数，可以在提交作业时通过代码设置
parameters.name: engine_params

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
The query execution mode. Valid values:

interactive (default)
batch
job

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189502.html
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型，取值说明：
interactive（默认值）：交互查询模式。
batch：分批查询模式。
Job：离线查询模式。

详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189502.html
parameters.name: group_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes. Default value: 0.

Each node is configured with the resources of 16 cores and 64 GB memory.
Make sure that the amount of resources of the nodes (Number of nodes × 16 cores and 64 GB memory) is less than or equal to the amount of unused resources of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点数量，默认值为0。
1个节点的资源量为16核64 GB。
节点数量不能过大，需满足节点数量*16核64 GB小于等于集群剩余可用资源
parameters.name: node_num

parameters.help_en: The database accounts with which to associate the resource group. They can be standard accounts or privileged accounts
parameters.help_zh: 需要绑定的数据库账号列表。既可以绑定数据库普通账号，也可以绑定数据库高权限账号
parameters.name: pool_user_list

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一。大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token
